jp: 先生[せんせい]{から/に|kara-source}宿題[しゅくだい]{の|no-possessive}ヒント{を|o-object}もらいました。
en: I got a hint for the homework from my teacher.
why: The person you receive something from is marked with から.

jp: 学校[がっこう]{から|kara-source}お知[し]らせ{が|ga-subject}届[とど]きました。
en: A notice arrived from the school.
why: A notice that arrives has a sender, marked with から.

jp: 会議[かいぎ]{で|de-place}、社員[しゃいん]{から|kara-source}いろいろな意見[いけん]{が|ga-subject}出[で]ました。
en: At the meeting, various opinions came from the staff.
why: The people that opinions or ideas come from are marked with から.

jp: 会社[かいしゃ]{の|no-possessive}同僚[どうりょう]{から/に|kara-source}会議[かいぎ]{の|no-possessive}資料[しりょう]{を|o-object}借[か]りました。
en: I borrowed the meeting materials from a colleague.
why: The lender of something borrowed is marked with から (or に).

jp: 山田[やまだ]さん{から/に|kara-source}、明日[あした]{の|no-possessive}授業[じゅぎょう]{は|wa-topic}休[やす]みだ{と|to-quote}聞[き]きました。
en: I heard from Ms. Yamada that tomorrow's class is cancelled.
why: The person you hear information from is marked with から (or に).

jp: この本[ほん]{は|wa-topic}友達[ともだち]{から/に|kara-source}すすめられました。
en: This book was recommended to me by a friend.
why: The person the recommendation comes from takes から (or に in a passive).

jp: 留学生[りゅうがくせい]{から/に|kara-source}英語[えいご]{の|no-possessive}発音[はつおん]{を|o-object}習[なら]いました。
en: I learned English pronunciation from an exchange student.
why: The person you learn from is marked with から (or に).

jp: 試験[しけん]{の|no-possessive}結果[けっか]{は|wa-topic}担任[たんにん]{の|no-possessive}先生[せんせい]{から|kara-source}伝[つた]えられます。
en: The exam results will be passed on by the homeroom teacher.
why: The person information is passed on from takes から; に here could be misread as passing it to the teacher.

jp: 授業[じゅぎょう]{で|de-place}、紙[かみ]{は|wa-topic}木[き]{から|kara-source}作[つく]られる{と|to-quote}習[なら]いました。
en: In class we learned that paper is made from wood.
why: The raw material that is transformed into the product takes から.

jp: 学食[がくしょく]{の|no-possessive}ジュース{は|wa-topic}本物[ほんもの]{の|no-possessive}みかん{から|kara-source}作[つく]られています。
en: The juice at the school cafeteria is made from real mandarin oranges.
why: The raw material that a product is made from takes から.

jp: 部長[ぶちょう]{から/に|kara-source}新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]{を|o-object}頼[たの]まれました。
en: I was asked to do a new job by the department head.
why: The person a request comes from is marked with から (or に in a passive).
